headline: Fronts Flare as Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle Burn
war_summary: Since the 21:10 edition the war has sharpened on a half‑dozen sectors. Weathered Expanse still leads the day with fifty‑nine ownership changes in twenty‑four hours, though the last two hours show no new flips; casualties remain extreme (≈786 colonial, 1,084 warden per hour) but the two‑hour trend has cooled. Stlican Shelf mirrors that pattern – fifty daily flips, eight in the past six hours, casualties accelerating to roughly 221 colonial and 349 warden per hour yet cooling on the two‑hour window. Stonecradle has surged anew, recording five flips in the last two hours and twenty‑seven on the day, with casualties spiking to about 279 colonial and 328 warden per hour. Linn Mercy adds two recent flips and eighteen daily, casualties climbing to 450 colonial and 681 warden per hour. Fresh hot‑spots have appeared: Fishermans Row logged six flips in two hours and thirteen on the day, both sides suffering accelerating losses (≈734 colonial, 872 warden per hour). Godcrofts likewise saw three flips in two hours and sixteen daily, with casualties rising sharply. Callahan’s Passage and Farranac Coast remain blood‑soaked but have produced no ownership changes in the last six hours. Elsewhere the front is quiet.
